content: Paper construction phase opened 2026-05-18. Canonical v1 (Cannabis_and_Human_Biology systems-first, 291 lines) now on disk and read in full alongside v2 (187 lines, verified-state rebuild) and the expansion file. All three sources verified-present, not memory-reconstructed. Identified central publishable thesis distinct from the investigation documents: the cannabis evidence base exhibits a STRUCTURAL ASYMMETRY -- best-supported claims narrow as evidence strengthens while broadest claims rest on weakest literatures -- and a tiered, product-specific, symmetric-evidence method makes that asymmetry visible where conventional narrative reviews obscure it. The ECS spine, indication ledger, psychosis causal-attenuation, and entourage three-way split become EVIDENCE for the methodological thesis rather than the endpoint. This reframes the deliverable from comprehensive-review (field has many) to epistemics-of-the-field paper with cannabis as worked case (original, defensible, and aligned with the 18-month Temple of Two methodological-record orientation). Recommended hybrid structure + both formats (md master + typeset PDF), awaiting Anthony scoping selection before build. All four v2 corrections carry into the paper: Vaucher-not-Gage, 2026-Ates-stratified-pain, three-part-entourage, component-cause-survives-attenuation; PK-entourage stays quarantined-unverified; pain stays real-but-small-conditional values-threshold judgment stated openly.
